title: Machine Learning-Based Radiomics for Molecular Subtyping of Gliomas

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Machine Learning-Based Radiomics for Molecular Subtyping of Gliomas》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Purpose: The new classification announced by the World Health Organization in 2016 recognized five molecular subtypes of diffuse gliomas based on isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) and 1p/19q genotypes in addition to histologic phenotypes.

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We aim to determine whether clinical MRI can stratify these molecular subtypes to benefit the diagnosis and monitoring of gliomas.Experimental Design: The data from 456 subjects with gliomas were obtained from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

evidence.text: Purpose: The new classification announced by the World Health Organization in 2016 recognized five molecular subtypes of diffuse gliomas based on isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) and 1p/19q genotypes in addition to histologic phenotypes.

We aim to determine whether clinical MRI can stratify these molecular subtypes to benefit the diagnosis and monitoring of gliomas.Experimental Design: The data from 456 subjects with gliomas were obtained from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Machine Learning-Based Radiomics for Molecular Subtyping of Gliomas》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】An independent dataset with 70 glioma subjects was further collected to verify the model performance.Results: The IDH and 1p/19q status of gliomas can be classified by radiomics and machine-learning approaches, with areas under ROC curves between 0.922 and 0.975 and accuracies between 87.7% and 96.1% estimated on the training dataset.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】The test on the validation dataset showed a comparable model performance with that on the training dataset, suggesting the efficacy of the trained classifiers.

evidence.text: An independent dataset with 70 glioma subjects was further collected to verify the model performance.Results: The IDH and 1p/19q status of gliomas can be classified by radiomics and machine-learning approaches, with areas under ROC curves between 0.922 and 0.975 and accuracies between 87.7% and 96.1% estimated on the training dataset.
The test on the validation dataset showed a comparable model performance with that on the training dataset, suggesting the efficacy of the trained classifiers.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Machine Learning-Based Radiomics for Molecular Subtyping of Gliomas》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】The classification of 5 molecular subtypes solely based on the MR phenotypes achieved an 81.8% accuracy, and a higher accuracy of 89.2% could be achieved if the histology diagnosis is available.Conclusions: The MR radiomics-based method provides a reliable alternative to determine the histology and molecular subtypes of gliomas.
